title: Recent-Increase Reduction of the Increase Limit (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
The recent-increase reduction on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the existing-customer increases that took effect on the agreement in the 24 months up to the handling date: two or more take **2 percentage points** off the limit percentage, one takes **1 point** off, and none takes nothing off. Points taken off never bring the limit percentage below zero (0 percent), so that a reduction never sets the rent below the rent before the increase.

The increases are read from the agreement's rent change history: notices with the reason existing-customer rate increase whose effective date falls in the 24 months up to the handling date. Retention concessions and reduction notices are not existing-customer increases.

| Existing-customer increases effective in the 24 months | Points off |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 1 March 2027)

- Increases effective 10 May 2025 and 10 May 2026: both within the 24 months, 2 points off.
- Increases effective 10 January 2025 and 10 May 2026: only the second is within the 24 months, 1 point off.
